task: Design a schematic sequence of six arrows containing exactly three right and three down moves, with exactly two heading changes. Initial alignment excluded.
plannedCheck: Record the student's literal sequence before checking it. Then compare move counts, endpoint and heading-change count using the new metric and direct arithmetic; preserve an incorrect attempt rather than silently replacing it.
scope: Schematic path-design exercise, not a path claimed feasible on the current obstacle/body model, a new map sample, motion planning objective or measured robotic trajectory.
